event.title: Khalil al-Hayya Elected as New Leader of Hamas Following Run-off
event.canonical_title: Khalil al-Hayya Elected as New Leader of Hamas Following Run-off
event.summary: Khalil al-Hayya has been elected as the new political chief of Hamas following a wartime election process. A founding member of the group, al-Hayya is recognized as a pragmatic leader and has survived previous attacks targeting Hamas leadership. His election comes at a critical time for the organization amid ongoing conflict.

timeline.title: Khalil al-Hayya Elected as New Leader of Hamas Following Run-off
timeline.summary: Khalil al-Hayya has been appointed as the new leader of Hamas after a run-off election against Khaled Meshaal. Al-Hayya, who was previously part of the five-member leadership council, succeeds Yahya Sinwar, who was killed by Israeli forces in 2024.
key_facts: Khalil al-Hayya has been elected as the new leader of Hamas.
He won a run-off election against Khaled Meshaal.
Al-Hayya was previously a member of the five-member leadership council.
Yahya Sinwar, the former leader, was killed by Israeli forces in 2024.
